critical_high_review.method: every evidence quote checked at its stated line; every Critical/High claim read against source; no severity or claim changed

scope: Expected observable configuration and declared-requirement defects. No assertion of a deployed exploit, real credentials, or runtime measurements.

scoring.unlisted_findings: Adjudicate on evidence; do not automatically mark false. Record draft-oracle corrections before any paid outputs; later corrections require a versioned rationale and rescore all runs.
scoring.counterexamples: Each prohibits only its named false claim, not every conceivable concern about that resource.
scoring.scope_disclosures: Score separately from issue recall; unsupported/unknown is not safe.
scoring.grouped_findings: One finding may match multiple IDs only if it explicitly establishes each defect and affected resource. Never count duplicate wording twice.

issues.title: Production records have no RDS automated backups
issues.expected_finding: backup_retention_period=0 disables RDS automated backups and its associated point-in-time recovery. The brief requires a 15-minute recovery point and declares no other database backup mechanism. Deletion protection/final snapshots do not meet that ongoing recovery requirement.
issues.severity_rationale: backup_retention_period=0 disables RDS automated backups and its associated point-in-time recovery. The brief requires a 15-minute recovery point and declares no other database backup mechanism. Deletion protection/final snapshots do not meet that ongoing recovery requirement.

issues.safe_remediation: Enable an appropriate positive backup retention period, schedule the zero-to-nonzero change with its possible outage, and test PITR restores. Validate the required RPO; do not claim backups alone deliver the stated recovery time.

issues.title: Evidence lifecycle retention contradicts the 90-day requirement
issues.expected_finding: The enabled lifecycle rule expires current objects after one day and noncurrent versions after one day. That makes required evidence eligible for deletion far before 90 days. Lifecycle execution is asynchronous, so do not assert deletion at an exact timestamp.
issues.severity_rationale: The enabled lifecycle rule expires current objects after one day and noncurrent versions after one day. That makes required evidence eligible for deletion far before 90 days. Lifecycle execution is asynchronous, so do not assert deletion at an exact timestamp.

issues.title: The standard-queue DLQ retains failures for only 60 seconds
issues.expected_finding: The source retains messages for four days but its DLQ retains them for 60 seconds. Standard queues preserve original enqueue age across redrive, so older failures can expire on arrival before the operator's daily inspection.
issues.severity_rationale: The source retains messages for four days but its DLQ retains them for 60 seconds. Standard queues preserve original enqueue age across redrive, so older failures can expire on arrival before the operator's daily inspection.

evidence.quote: no separate archive. Failed standard-queue messages are inspected every day.

issues.safe_remediation: Set the DLQ retention above source retention, such as 14 days, and alarm on failures. Investigate poison messages before controlled redrive; do not purge the DLQ or increase receive attempts indefinitely.

safe_counterexamples.must_not_report: The database is publicly accessible or stores an inline plaintext master password.
safe_counterexamples.why_safe_for_this_claim: publicly_accessible=false, encrypted storage, private-CIDR ingress, and managed master-user credentials are explicit. Other database reliability issues still apply.

safe_counterexamples.must_not_report: The wildcard principal grants public access to evidence, or new S3 objects are unencrypted.
safe_counterexamples.why_safe_for_this_claim: This statement is a Deny of insecure transport, not an Allow. Bucket public-access blocks are enabled, and new objects have S3's default encryption.

safe_counterexamples.must_not_report: TTL is disabled or TTL guarantees deletion precisely when a session expires.
safe_counterexamples.why_safe_for_this_claim: TTL is enabled and the application rejects expired sessions independently. Physical TTL deletion is asynchronous; enabled TTL is not a security authorization control.

evidence.quote: Sessions set expires_at on every item; application checks enforce session expiry
